scope: Validation only; prespecified final endpoints, never best checkpoint selection
warnings: 20 rollout steps cannot establish that degradation near step 400 is fixed.
Behavioral and numerical variants are a bundled intervention, not the unpublished author implementation; do not attribute effects to a single factor.
Greater RLen alone is not an improvement; inspect success, valid actions and length together.
Four samples are clustered by task; confidence intervals omit training-seed variability.
Test and holdout scores are not loaded or used.

metric_definition.response_length: mean total sampled assistant token IDs per trajectory, including EOS
metric_definition.success: raw environment outcome > 0, without training penalties
metric_definition.pass_at_4: fraction of tasks with at least one success in four samples

training.costs_scope: Committed step logs plus known discarded iterations; model loading and incomplete failed work excluded. Endpoint/initial evaluation costs are separate.

endpoint_minus_initial.bootstrap_unit: task, preserving the cluster of four samples
endpoint_minus_initial.confidence_scope: Finite-validation-task uncertainty only; one training seed cannot estimate training variance

mcnemar_pass_at_4.note: Exploratory, no multiple-comparison correction; no independent-trajectory p-value reported
